description: This file defines a PHP trait 'LeaveEntitlementServiceTrait' within the OrangeHRM project. The trait provides a method to access the 'LeaveEntitlementService' from a container, facilitating dependency injection and service management within the Leave plugin's service layer.

methods.name: getLeaveEntitlementService
methods.description: Returns an instance of LeaveEntitlementService from the service container, enabling the use of this service within classes using this trait.
